name: Rosewood Abu Dhabi
positioning: Waterfront city hotel on Al Maryah Island with a Cantonese restaurant, a hidden speakeasy and a gin bar
best_for: Travelers who plan evenings around bars and dining without leaving the hotel
Families wanting a kids' program in a city hotel

facts.text: Rosewood Abu Dhabi is on Al Maryah Island.
The accommodation blends contemporary elegance, local influence and waterfront views.
Dai Pai Dong is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant.
Dai Pai Dong serves a Yum Cha dim sum brunch with dumplings, roasted meats and desserts.
Hidden Bar focuses on gin, with a gin collection and house-infused vermouths.
Hidden Bar has a terrace looking over the water at sunset.
La Cava is a wine lounge serving aged vintages and fire-grilled prime cuts with Spanish flair.
La Cava runs a whiskey tasting series covering spirits from Scotland, Japan, India and the Americas.
Em Sherif Sea Café offers lunch and dinner menus, coffee, live music and shisha.
Glo is an open-air poolside bar, and a Pool Pass is available.
Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers treatments that honor local healing traditions.
In-room dining runs from breakfast to late night.

highlights.text: Dragon's Tooth is a speakeasy bar inspired by the 1920s Shanghai jazz movement, reached through the Tea Room of Dai Pai Dong.
Majlis by Pierre Hermé combines the setting of a majlis with a Parisian patisserie and Pierre Hermé's creations.
A residential fresh market sells hydroponic greens, herbs, edible flowers and artisanal bakery items.
Aqua has panoramic 180-degree views and crystal chandeliers.
Rosewood Explorers is a program of activities and amenities designed for young guests.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that the island location means arranging transportation to mainland attractions.
